facts.business: Benara Bearings & Pistons Limited manufactures bearings and pistons.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Disclaimer of opinion due to: 1) Inventories of ₹932.32 lakhs include slow-moving/non-tradable items with incomplete physical verification; 2) Unable to verify recoverability of Other Non-Current Assets (₹1,043.27 lakhs) and Long-Term Loans & Advances (₹902.88 lakhs) despite impairment provisions; 3) Non-recognition of interest expense on NPA borrowings due to ongoing OTS negotiations; 4) No depreciation on Intangible Assets (₹481.18 lakhs); 5) Non-recognition of income tax demands (₹9,708.96 lakhs) and GST demands (₹864.80 lakhs); 6) Trade payables not classified per MSMED Act; 7) Balances subject to confirmation; 8) Cash losses of ₹129.56 lakhs and negative net worth raising going concern doubt; 9) Non-compliance with Section 203 (Company Secretary vacancy).
